programme.title: Now You See Me: Now You Don't
programme.desc: The Four Horsemen join forces with a new generation of illusionists for a global high-stakes heist, performing mind-melding magic as they try to take down an international crime syndicate.

programme.title: Road House (2024)
programme.desc: A troubled ex-UFC fighter takes a job as a bouncer at a Florida Keys roadhouse, only to discover that this paradise is not all it seems. An adrenaline-fueled remake of the cult classic film.

programme.title: Babygirl
programme.desc: A high-powered CEO puts her career and family on the line when she begins a torrid affair with her much younger intern.

programme.title: Small Things Like These

programme.title: One Mile: Chapter Two
programme.desc: When the same violent community abducts his daughter again in an act of revenge, Daniel launches a relentless hunt, facing an enemy who anticipates his every move.

programme.title: Four Mothers
programme.desc: A writer about to publish his new novel is forced to take care of his mother and three eccentric older women over the course of one chaotic weekend in Dublin.

programme.title: The Long Walk
programme.desc: In a dystopian United States under military rule, a group of teen boys compete in an annual contest known as The Long Walk, where they must maintain a certain walking speed or get shot. Based on Stephen King's iconic novel.

programme.title: Riley

programme.title: Fear Below

programme.title: Yoroi
programme.desc: Rap star Aurelien settles in Japan with his wife. There, he finds an ancient suit of armour that compels him to fight creatures from Japanese folklore every night. Contains English Subtitles.

programme.title: The Housemaid
programme.desc: Hoping to escape her past, Millie takes a job as a live-in housemaid for a wealthy couple. But she soon discovers that behind the Winchester's closed doors, their secrets are far more dangerous than her own.

programme.title: The Best You Can
programme.desc: A chance encounter leads security guard Stan and urologist Cynthia to form an unexpected friendship. Over time, their deepening bond shakes up both of their lives.

programme.title: Bike Heist
programme.desc: To earn money to support his family, Ash joins a moped bike gang who commit petty thefts to make ends meet. Pulled in by the allure of fast cash, Ash soon gets drawn into the web of an organised crime ring.

programme.title: Suncoast
programme.desc: Living in the shadow of her brother's serious illness, and clashing with her strong-willed mother, a teenager strikes up a friendship with an eccentric activist protesting outside the hospice where her brother is being cared for.

programme.title: Jane Austen Wrecked My Life
programme.desc: A romantically challenged aspiring novelist attends a Jane Austen Writers' Residency in England, where she gets caught in an unexpected love triangle. Contains English Subtitles.

programme.title: Riley
programme.desc: The life of a disciplined high school athlete begins to unravel when his queer identity competes against the idea of who he was supposed to be.

programme.title: Regretting You
programme.desc: A mother and daughter must grapple with what's left after a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal - forcing them to confront family secrets, redefine love, and rediscover themselves.

programme.desc: Hoping to escape her past, Millie takes a job as a live-in housemaid for a wealthy couple. But she soon discovers that behind the Winchester's closed doors, their secrets are far more dangerous than her own.

programme.title: Twinless
programme.desc: Grieving the loss of his brother, Roman joins a support group for "twinless twins". There, he befriends a man who harbours a dark secret.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Many years after Caesar's reign, a young ape goes on a journey that'll lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past.
